# Civics Tests — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Complete preparation for civics and citizenship tests across countries.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Us-Citizenship

- [Us Citizenship](https://civics-tests.wyattau.com/us-citizenship/): This section covers us citizenship concepts, definitions, and applications with worked examples and practice problems.
- [US Citizenship English Test | civics-tests](https://civics-tests.wyattau.com/us-citizenship/english-test/): US Citizenship English Test - Complete study guide and practice questions
- [US Citizenship Process](https://civics-tests.wyattau.com/us-citizenship/citizenship-process/): Complete guide to the US naturalisation process including eligibility, application, interview, and oath ceremony.
- [US Civics Questions | civics-tests](https://civics-tests.wyattau.com/us-citizenship/civics-questions/): - New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas
- [US Civics Test Practice](https://civics-tests.wyattau.com/us-citizenship/practice-test/): Complete practice test for the US citizenship civics exam with all 100 official USCIS questions and answers.
